description: Estimate ETH Up or Down probability for a fixed 5-minute window from caller-supplied prices.

fee_bps.description: Optional estimated entry fee in basis points.

market_down_price.description: Optional caller-supplied DOWN share price for model-edge comparison.

market_up_price.description: Optional caller-supplied UP share price for model-edge comparison.

observations.description: Eight to 240 caller-supplied observations ordered oldest to newest.

price.description: Finite caller-supplied asset price in the supported numeric range.

window_close_timestamp.description: Unix close timestamp in seconds, later than the newest observation.

window_open_price.description: Caller-supplied opening price under the target venue's own rules.

name: estimate_ethereum_up_down_5m
